entries.388db5952b429810: This is a single-segment business that develops, manufactures and sells Stebolonin®, a boron drug (generic name: borofalan (10B)) used in BNCT (boron neutron capture therapy), a radiation therapy that selectively destroys cancer cells. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥323 million. The head office (Chuo-ku, Osaka) is disclosed as an office, and the research laboratory (Naka-ku, Sakai) is disclosed as research and development facilities.
